title: Build bounded receive and reassembly
runtime_identity: Linux 6.18.44 x86_64, 2 vCPU, Node v22.22.2, Chromium 1194; loopback only
decision_or_code_delta: gateway/ws.js: Bounded receive: caps from headers, in-place unmask, single-copy reassembly, reservation before buffer.
expected: Accepted messages reconstruct exactly; oversized, incomplete, and malformed inputs cannot exceed admitted storage or execute partial terminal commands.
memory_scope: gateway process (+ worker threads) and worker processes
residual_risks: self-reviewed by the implementer; no independent verification
rollback: delete ram/, gateway/worker-link.js, worker/core.js, worker/thread.js; restore the v1 files from hermit-vws 1.1.0-vws.1 (hashes in ledger/ramws_source.json)
linked_tests: declared 64-bit length over the cap -> 1009 from the header alone (no payload sent)
fragmented message over the cap -> 1009 before buffering the offending fragment
split UTF-8 character across fragments is reassembled before strict decoding
stalled fragment assembly hits the deadline -> 1008
